title: Equivariant noncommutative crepant resolutions and $G$-maximal modifying modules
summary: Let $S$ be a Cohen-Macaulay normal domain containing a field $k$ with an action of a finite group $G$ with $|G|$ invertible in $k$. We prove that $G$-equivariant noncommutative crepant resolutions of $S$ induce noncommutative crepant resolutions of $S^G$ if the $G$-action is small. We also discuss similar results for equivariant maximal modification algebras. We introduce the notion of $G$-maximal modifying ($G$-MM) module, and we show that $G$-MM module over $S$ induces MM $S^G$-module in some special cases.
